flowCatalog.Label: Loaner Asset | Asynchronous, on create, Loaner Serial Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS dlrs__LookupRollupSummary2.Loaner_Assets_Serial (on create). Concatenates Loaner_Serial__c from child Loaner_Asset__c records onto Loaner__c.Loaner_Serial__c. No delimiter; sorted by LastModifiedDate ASC; null serials excluded; 255-char truncation guard (adjust if Loaner_Serial__c on Loaner__c is longer). Runs async to stay outside the creating transaction. Bulk note: concurrent creates on the same parent may cause row-lock contention at very high volume.

flowCatalog.Label: Loaner Asset | Asynchronous, on update, Loaner Location Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/03/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Loaner_Assets_Location rule. Recalculates Loaner__c.Loaner_Location__c when a Loaner Asset is reparented (Loaner__c changes). Concatenates distinct Loaner_Location__c values (space-delimited) for the new parent. Note: old parent is not recalculated — $Record__Prior is unavailable in async paths.

flowCatalog.Label: Loaner Asset | Before Delete, Loaner Asset Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – DLRS-replacement: Loaner_Assets_Roll_Up (before delete). Loop over Transform: no ConcatenateDistinct, formula field (ProductItem__r.Name), no delimiter/truncation control.

flowCatalog.Label: Loaner Asset | Before Delete, Loaner Location Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/03/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Loaner_Assets_Location rule. Re-concatenates remaining Loaner_Asset__c.Loaner_Location__c values (space-delimited) onto Loaner__c.Loaner_Location__c before a Loaner Asset is deleted. Excludes the record being deleted from the query. Loaner_Is_Null_Check prevents SOQL when Loaner__c is blank.

flowCatalog.Label: Loaner Asset | Before Delete, Loaner Serial Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS dlrs__LookupRollupSummary2.Loaner_Assets_Serial (before delete). Recalculates Loaner__c.Loaner_Serial__c by concatenating Loaner_Serial__c from remaining child Loaner_Asset__c records (excluding the record being deleted). No delimiter; sorted by LastModifiedDate ASC; null serials excluded; 255-char truncation guard. When no siblings remain, writes blank (null) to the parent field. Runs synchronously; async paths are not supported in Before Delete context.

flowCatalog.Label: Loaner Asset | On Update, Loaner Asset Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – DLRS-replacement: Loaner_Assets_Roll_Up (on update). Sync path for $Record__Prior (old parent on reparent). Loop over Transform: no ConcatenateDistinct, formula field (ProductItem__r.Name), no delimiter/truncation control.

flowCatalog.Label: Loaner Asset | On Update, Loaner Serial Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS dlrs__LookupRollupSummary2.Loaner_Assets_Serial (on update). Concatenates Loaner_Serial__c from child Loaner_Asset__c records onto Loaner__c.Loaner_Serial__c. No delimiter; sorted by LastModifiedDate ASC; null serials excluded; 255-char truncation guard. Handles reparenting: updates both new and old parent when Loaner__c changes. Known gap: if Loaner__c is cleared to null, the old parent is not recalculated (entry criteria require Loaner__c to be non-null post-update). Bulk note: concurrent updates on the same parent may cause row-lock contention at very high volume.

Excludes the record being deleted and any records with null Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c. Sets parent to null when no qualifying records remain. Entry criteria and null check prevent execution when Purchasing_Opportunity__c is blank or the deleted record had no value in Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c.

flowCatalog.Label: ProductItem | Before delete, Rental Order Price Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/03/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Rental_Order_Price rule (on delete). Runs synchronously before delete (Salesforce does not support async after-delete flows). Queries remaining ProductItems on the Rental Order (excluding the record being deleted) and writes the summed Sales_Price__c to Rental_Order__c.Rental_Amount__c. Entry criteria guards against null Rental_Order__c to avoid unnecessary SOQL.

flowCatalog.Label: ProductItem | Before delete, Starting Bid Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/01/26 (GD) – Created to replace the DLRS Starting_Bid rollup (on delete). Runs synchronously before delete. Queries remaining ProductItems on the Purchasing Opportunity (excluding the record being deleted) and writes the summed Starting_Bid__c to Opportunity.Starting_Bid__c.

flowCatalog.Label: ProductItem | on update, Pur Op Total Cost Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/01/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS TotalCostOfAssetsOnPurchasingOp rule. On update when Cost__c or Purchasing_Opportunity__c changes, sums ProductItem__c.Cost__c onto Opportunity.Total_Cost_of_Assets__c. Runs synchronously to support reparenting via $Record__Prior. On reparent, updates both old and new Opportunity.

flowCatalog.Label: ProductItem | on update, Pur Op Working Capital Usage Days Roll Up
flowCatalog.Description: 06/01/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Working_Capital_Usage_Days_Roll_Up rule. On update when Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c or Purchasing_Opportunity__c changes, averages ProductItem__c.Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c onto Opportunity.Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c. Only includes records where Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c is not null. Sets parent to null when no qualifying records exist. Runs synchronously to support reparenting via $Record__Prior. On reparent, updates both old and new Opportunity.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | Asynchronous, on create, Loaner Asset Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Loaner_Assets_Roll_Up rule. Concatenates distinct Loaner_Asset__c.Loaner_Asset__c (ProductItem Name) values comma-delimited, truncated to 255 chars, onto Loaner__c.Loaner_Asset__c when a Loaner Asset is created. Loaner_Is_Null_Check prevents SOQL when Loaner__c is blank.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | Asynchronous, on create, Loaner Asset Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – DLRS-replacement: Loaner_Assets_Roll_Up (on create). Loop over Transform: no ConcatenateDistinct, formula field (ProductItem__r.Name), no delimiter/truncation control.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | Asynchronous, on create, Loaner Location Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/03/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Loaner_Assets_Location rule. Concatenates distinct Loaner_Asset__c.Loaner_Location__c values (space-delimited) onto Loaner__c.Loaner_Location__c when a Loaner Asset is created. Loaner_Is_Null_Check decision prevents SOQL when Loaner__c is blank.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | Asynchronous, on create, Loaner Serial Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS dlrs__LookupRollupSummary2.Loaner_Assets_Serial (on create). Concatenates Loaner_Serial__c from child Loaner_Asset__c records onto Loaner__c.Loaner_Serial__c. No delimiter; sorted by LastModifiedDate ASC; null serials excluded; 255-char truncation guard (adjust if Loaner_Serial__c on Loaner__c is longer). Runs async to stay outside the creating transaction. Bulk note: concurrent creates on the same parent may cause row-lock contention at very high volume.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | Asynchronous, on update, Loaner Location Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/03/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Loaner_Assets_Location rule. Recalculates Loaner__c.Loaner_Location__c when a Loaner Asset is reparented (Loaner__c changes). Concatenates distinct Loaner_Location__c values (space-delimited) for the new parent. Note: old parent is not recalculated — $Record__Prior is unavailable in async paths.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | Before Delete, Loaner Asset Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Loaner_Assets_Roll_Up rule. Re-concatenates remaining Loaner_Asset__c.Loaner_Asset__c (ProductItem Name) values comma-delimited, truncated to 255 chars, onto Loaner__c.Loaner_Asset__c before a Loaner Asset is deleted. Excludes the record being deleted from the query. Loaner_Is_Null_Check prevents SOQL when Loaner__c is blank.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | Before Delete, Loaner Asset Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – DLRS-replacement: Loaner_Assets_Roll_Up (before delete). Loop over Transform: no ConcatenateDistinct, formula field (ProductItem__r.Name), no delimiter/truncation control.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | Before Delete, Loaner Location Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/03/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Loaner_Assets_Location rule. Re-concatenates remaining Loaner_Asset__c.Loaner_Location__c values (space-delimited) onto Loaner__c.Loaner_Location__c before a Loaner Asset is deleted. Excludes the record being deleted from the query. Loaner_Is_Null_Check prevents SOQL when Loaner__c is blank.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | Before Delete, Loaner Serial Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS dlrs__LookupRollupSummary2.Loaner_Assets_Serial (before delete). Recalculates Loaner__c.Loaner_Serial__c by concatenating Loaner_Serial__c from remaining child Loaner_Asset__c records (excluding the record being deleted). No delimiter; sorted by LastModifiedDate ASC; null serials excluded; 255-char truncation guard. When no siblings remain, writes blank (null) to the parent field. Runs synchronously; async paths are not supported in Before Delete context.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | On Update, Loaner Asset Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Loaner_Assets_Roll_Up rule. Synchronous after-save update flow (RecordAfterSave) so $Record__Prior is available. Branch A: Loaner__c changed — recalculates both the new parent and old parent rollups. Branch B: ProductItem__c changed (same Loaner) — recalculates current parent only. Concatenates distinct Loaner_Asset__c (ProductItem Name) values comma-delimited, truncated to 255 chars, onto Loaner__c.Loaner_Asset__c.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | On Update, Loaner Asset Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – DLRS-replacement: Loaner_Assets_Roll_Up (on update). Sync path for $Record__Prior (old parent on reparent). Loop over Transform: no ConcatenateDistinct, formula field (ProductItem__r.Name), no delimiter/truncation control.

flowVersions.Label: Loaner Asset | On Update, Loaner Serial Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS dlrs__LookupRollupSummary2.Loaner_Assets_Serial (on update). Concatenates Loaner_Serial__c from child Loaner_Asset__c records onto Loaner__c.Loaner_Serial__c. No delimiter; sorted by LastModifiedDate ASC; null serials excluded; 255-char truncation guard. Handles reparenting: updates both new and old parent when Loaner__c changes. Known gap: if Loaner__c is cleared to null, the old parent is not recalculated (entry criteria require Loaner__c to be non-null post-update). Bulk note: concurrent updates on the same parent may cause row-lock contention at very high volume.

flowVersions.Label: MC Shipment | Before Delete, Delivered Date Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS rollup 'Roll Up Delivered Date on Loaner' (before delete). Queries all remaining MCShipments for the triggered Loaner — the being-deleted record is excluded via Id != $Record.Id filter. Concatenates distinct Actual_Delivery_Date__c values (YYYY-MM-DD, comma-delimited) onto Loaner.Delivered_Date__c. Synchronous only; no async paths are supported in Before Delete flows. Distinct check uses anchored CONTAINS() pattern (",value,") to prevent substring false-positives.

flowVersions.Label: MC Shipment | Before Delete, Ship Date Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS rollup 'Roll Up Loaner Ship Date' (before delete). Queries all remaining MCShipments for the triggered Loaner — the being-deleted record is excluded via Id != $Record.Id filter. Concatenates distinct Ship_Date__c values (YYYY-MM-DD, comma-delimited) onto Loaner.Ship_Date__c. Synchronous only; no async paths are supported in Before Delete flows. Distinct check uses anchored CONTAINS() pattern (",value,") to prevent substring false-positives.

flowVersions.Label: MC Shipment | On Create, Delivered Date Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/04/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS rollup 'Roll Up Delivered Date on Loaner' (on create). Queries all MCShipments for the triggered Loaner and concatenates distinct Actual_Delivery_Date__c values (YYYY-MM-DD, comma-delimited) onto Loaner.Delivered_Date__c. Distinct check uses anchored CONTAINS() pattern (",value,") to prevent substring false-positives. AggregateAllRows: false — soft-deleted rows excluded by default SOQL.

Excludes the record being deleted from the concatenation. Loaner_Is_Null_Check decision prevents SOQL when Loaner__c is blank.
06/01/26 (GD) – Added Loaner__c IsNull false entry criteria to prevent execution on every ProductItem delete when no Loaner is set.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | Before delete, Max Bid Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 05/28/26 (GD) – Created to replace the DLRS Max_Bid rollup (on delete). Runs synchronously before delete (Salesforce does not support async after-delete flows). Queries remaining ProductItems on the Purchasing Opportunity (excluding the record being deleted) and writes the summed Max_Bid__c to Opportunity.Max_Bid__c.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | Before delete, Max Bid Roll Up

06/01/26 (GD) – Updated entry criteria

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | Before delete, Number of Checked In Items PO Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 05/28/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS rule NumberOfCheckedInItemsPO delete path. Runs before the ProductItem is deleted; excludes the being-deleted record from the re-query so Opportunity.Number_of_Checked_In_Items__c is accurate after deletion.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | Before Delete, Pur Op Total Cost of Unsold Assets Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/01/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS TotalCostOfUnsoldAssetsPurchasing rule. Before delete, re-sums remaining ProductItem__c.Cost__c where Sold__c = false onto Opportunity.Total_Cost_of_Unsold_Assets__c. Excludes the record being deleted. Entry criteria and null check prevent execution when Purchasing_Opportunity__c is blank or record was already sold.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | Before Delete, Pur Op Total Cost Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/01/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS TotalCostOfAssetsOnPurchasingOp rule. Before delete, re-sums remaining ProductItem__c.Cost__c onto Opportunity.Total_Cost_of_Assets__c. Excludes the record being deleted from the sum. Entry criteria and Purchasing_Opportunity_Is_Null_Check prevent execution when Purchasing_Opportunity__c is blank.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | Before Delete, Pur Op Working Capital Usage Days Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/01/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Working_Capital_Usage_Days_Roll_Up rule. Before delete, re-averages remaining ProductItem__c.Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c onto Opportunity.Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c. Excludes the record being deleted and any records with null Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c. Sets parent to null when no qualifying records remain. Entry criteria and null check prevent execution when Purchasing_Opportunity__c is blank or the deleted record had no value in Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | Before delete, Rental Order Price Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/03/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS Rental_Order_Price rule (on delete). Runs synchronously before delete (Salesforce does not support async after-delete flows). Queries remaining ProductItems on the Rental Order (excluding the record being deleted) and writes the summed Sales_Price__c to Rental_Order__c.Rental_Amount__c. Entry criteria guards against null Rental_Order__c to avoid unnecessary SOQL.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | Before delete, Starting Bid Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/01/26 (GD) – Created to replace the DLRS Starting_Bid rollup (on delete). Runs synchronously before delete. Queries remaining ProductItems on the Purchasing Opportunity (excluding the record being deleted) and writes the summed Starting_Bid__c to Opportunity.Starting_Bid__c.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | Before delete, Starting Bid Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/01/26 (GD) – Created to replace the DLRS Starting_Bid rollup (on delete). Runs synchronously before delete. Queries remaining ProductItems on the Purchasing Opportunity (excluding the record being deleted) and writes the summed Starting_Bid__c to Opportunity.Starting_Bid__c.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | on update, Pur Op Total Cost of Unsold Assets Roll Up
flowVersions.Description: 06/01/26 (GD) – Replaces DLRS TotalCostOfUnsoldAssetsPurchasing rule. On update when Cost__c, Sold__c, or Purchasing_Opportunity__c changes, sums ProductItem__c.Cost__c where Sold__c = false onto Opportunity.Total_Cost_of_Unsold_Assets__c. Runs synchronously to support reparenting via $Record__Prior. On reparent, updates both old and new Opportunity.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | on update, Pur Op Working Capital Usage Days Roll Up

On update when Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c or Purchasing_Opportunity__c changes, averages ProductItem__c.Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c onto Opportunity.Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c. Only includes records where Working_Capital_Usage_Days__c is not null. Sets parent to null when no qualifying records exist. Runs synchronously to support reparenting via $Record__Prior. On reparent, updates both old and new Opportunity.

flowVersions.Label: ProductItem | on update, Rental Order Price Roll Up

flowVersions.Description: This template is provisioned with all the variables users can play with in order to create conditionals/decision elements to determine which gateway to use by any Chargent operation (except Charge-Authorized a.k.a. Capture). It also has a simple use case example where a gateway is determined according to the billingState. So if the billingState is equals to 'California' the output variable 'routingGateway' is set with gatewayA Id, otherwise with gatewayB Id.
